C5.rationale: Anchor Level 2: 'Students design and conduct an inquiry with methodology selection and data collection, assessed.' MGMT90286 requires students to test and validate their business idea and iterate using customer/stakeholder feedback, with a compulsory, assessed validation-plan hurdle preceding graded validation-test work. Level 3 additionally requires methodology 'defended under scrutiny (viva, defence, or staged supervised review)'; the validation-plan hurdle gates progress but the extract does not document a defence or review of the methodology itself, so the item is held at 2 (see ambiguities).

W1.rationale: Anchor Level 2: 'at least one core assessment requires a recognised professional genre or an audience beyond the teaching team ... pitch ... judged against criteria drawn from professional practice.' The capstone assesses an investor-style pitch in both MGMT90230 ('produce a pitch document and give a presentation', 'Demonstrate skills in pitching entrepreneurial ideas to the investor community') and MGMT90286 ('Group pitch presentation (15 mins) and accompanying poster (400 words)'). W2.rationale: Anchor Level 2: 'at least one core assessment reproduces a professional task end to end: a real or realistic problem, producing the artefact a practitioner would produce, judged against criteria drawn from practice.' The New Venture Creation capstone has students build and pitch an actual venture, learn to 'establish viability of their entrepreneurial concepts and pivot their initial models', and apply lean-startup/design-thinking methodology to a real business model. Level 3 requires this to be 'the program's assessment spine ... a capstone plus earlier scaffolding, or at least one per stage'; the other four compulsory core units remain case-study-based with academic artefacts and criteria in the extract, so the spine requirement is not documented (see ambiguities).

ambiguities: C2: MGMT90229's reflective written assignments (personal entrepreneurial abilities, ethical decision making, becoming an entrepreneur) are assessed but the extract documents no explicit marking criteria for the appraisal, straddling Level 0 ('no assessment requires appraising quality of work') and Level 1 ('reflection appears in outcomes ... not assessed against criteria') — resolved to Level 1, the anchor matching the documented reflective-learning outcome and assessed reflective writing, and not resolved upward to Level 2 absent documented criteria.

C5: MGMT90286's validation-plan hurdle ('cannot proceed ... without successfully completing this task') reads as a staged supervised-review checkpoint that could support Level 3's 'defended under scrutiny', but the extract does not document an actual defence or review of the methodology itself (only a pass/fail gate before proceeding) — resolved to Level 2 per the lower-level rule.

W2: The two-subject New Venture Creation capstone reproduces the venture-creation and validation process end to end with real customer feedback, which could be read as the program's assessment spine across two stages (Level 3); but the extract documents no comparably authentic, end-to-end professional task design in the four other compulsory core units (MGMT90225, FNCE90089, MGMT90228, MGMT90229), which remain case-study/academic in artefact and criteria — resolved to Level 2 per the lower-level rule.
